body: My nose twitches as I catch the scent of dog food wafting from the crates. I approach cautiously, not wanting to startle the creatures. As I move closer, I see several dogs with matted fur, some of them shivering. My instinct tells me that these aren't pets but strays, possibly abandoned. I reach out to touch one of their ears, feeling the rough fur and the warmth of their bodies.
